entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...So how was it? The school, I mean.[n]Think you can manage?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Do you even understand your situation?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You brought it on yourself though.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Now listen up. Don't even think of doing[n]anything stupid.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: In any case, one school already tossed[n]you out. You thought you'd get a new[n]start over here?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: That folks would sympathize with you?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...If it was that rough at school, I bet I'll[n]get some bad rep too...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What a troublesome kid I've taken in...
Why did you take me in?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I was asked to do it, and I just... happened[n]to agree to it.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I've already been paid for it too, after all.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: Again, a subway has derailed at Shibuya[n]Station, greatly affecting the timetable[n]all across the—

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: So that's why it's so crowded. There's been[n]a lot of those lately.
